scientific_question: At the native adjacent-frame relation containing a frozen coordinate, does the controlled mix exhibit greater full-spectrum signed spectral-evolution correspondence with the contemporaneous BassDI evolution at MISSED BassDI coordinates than at frozen NEGATIVE coordinates?
hypothesis: MISSED coordinates have greater signed local spectral-evolution correspondence between the controlled mix and contemporaneous BassDI than frozen non-event coordinates, while remaining statistically unresolved from PRESERVED coordinates under the frozen interval rule.

confirmatory_family.independence: All four observables are components of one family and cannot be counted as independent confirmations. Descriptive observables cannot rescue, alter or enter classification.

bassdi_stft.role: post-PRE-GT comparison authority only; forbidden before PRE-GT commit

compatibility_requirements.required_checks: frequency arrays exactly equal; mix frame-start array exactly equals BassDI prefix through the shared scope; no transformation, realignment, resampling, rebinning or normalization correction permitted

pre_gt_representation.reuse: Read and checksum-verify the existing authoritative mix STFT in place; do not recompute, copy or rewrite it.
pre_gt_representation.eligible_relation: For every pair of consecutive mix STFT rows (i,i+1), preserve relation identity i, start samples s_i and s_(i+1), and availability.
pre_gt_representation.spectral_state: For each frame i, S_i(f)=P_i(f)/sum_f(P_i(f)) over all 744 frozen bins. If total power is zero or non-finite, state is null and unavailable with explicit reason.
pre_gt_representation.spectral_structures: The complete frozen power vectors preserve all frequency-bin amplitudes, alternative harmonic/F0 interpretations, individual partial evidence, competing structures and ambiguity without selecting or labelling any structure.
pre_gt_representation.storage: Preserve lightweight relation coordinates, availability and deterministic bindings to reconstruct S, Delta, R and D exactly from the authoritative STFT. Do not duplicate dense arrays already exactly derivable from the STFT.

pre_gt_firewall.requirements: Fingerprint and commit the complete PRE-GT relation authority, deterministic reconstruction bindings, availability and replay verification before opening BassDI representation or outcome authority. Verify that commit exists before post-freeze evaluation.

post_freeze_representation.bassdi: After verified PRE-GT commit, checksum-verify and open BassDI STFT; apply the identical S, Delta, R and D definitions independently over its shared-scope prefix.
post_freeze_representation.no_transformation: No alignment, correction, resampling, rebinning, smoothing, normalization beyond S, or outcome-conditioned modification.

coordinate_projection.timestamp_parse: Parse the frozen JSON timestamp numeric lexeme as an exact base-10 Decimal; do not first convert it to binary float.
coordinate_projection.containment: The projected native relation is the unique i satisfying s_i/44100 <= timestamp < s_(i+1)/44100 under exact decimal/rational comparison. Equality at s_(i+1) belongs to relation i+1.
coordinate_projection.availability: Projection is unavailable with explicit reason if i<0, i+1 is outside shared mix scope, required state/evolution is unavailable, or an observable-specific vector norm is zero/non-finite.

correspondence_measurements.signed_local_spectral_evolution_correspo: cosine(Delta_mix_i,Delta_BassDI_i); decision-bearing; unavailable if either norm is zero/non-finite
correspondence_measurements.positive_rearticulation_correspondence: cosine(R_mix_i,R_BassDI_i); descriptive only; unavailable if either norm is zero/non-finite
correspondence_measurements.negative_decay_correspondence: cosine(D_mix_i,D_BassDI_i); descriptive only; unavailable if either norm is zero/non-finite
correspondence_measurements.range: cosine values [-1,1]; spectral-state correspondence [0,1] subject only to floating-point roundoff
correspondence_measurements.interpretation: Greater values mean greater contemporaneous numerical correspondence under that observable, not source identity.

evaluation_populations.PRESERVED: Reuse exactly the frozen PRESERVED coordinates in the checksum-bound outcome authority.
evaluation_populations.MISSED: Reuse exactly the frozen MISSED coordinates in the checksum-bound outcome authority.
evaluation_populations.NEGATIVE: Reuse exactly the FROZEN NON-EVENT COORDINATES in the checksum-bound outcome authority; they are not verified Bass absence.
evaluation_populations.modification: No coordinate derivation, exclusion, replacement, matching, tolerance or population modification.

statistics.orientation: Positive Cliff's delta and rank AUC above 0.5 mean the first population has greater correspondence.

bootstrap.method: independent within-population percentile bootstrap for Cliff's delta
bootstrap.seed: 20260902 + observable_ordinal*3 + comparison_ordinal, with zero-based ordinals in the frozen orders

statistics.multiplicity: No multiplicity correction and no confirmatory p-value interpretation; classification uses only the two frozen signed-evolution intervals.

availability_invariant.scope: signed local spectral-evolution correspondence must be available for at least 80 percent of each PRESERVED, MISSED and NEGATIVE population
availability_invariant.role: evidence-sufficiency invariant only; not a correspondence or source decision threshold

decision_rule_priority.INDETERMINATE: Any authority, checksum, numerical compatibility, PRE-GT firewall, replay, projection, serialization or availability invariant fails.
decision_rule_priority.EVENT_BLIND_LOCAL_SPECTRAL_EVOLUTION_COR: MISSED-minus-NEGATIVE signed-evolution Cliff's-delta 95% CI lower bound is >0 AND MISSED-minus-PRESERVED signed-evolution CI satisfies lower bound <=0<= upper bound.
MISSED-minus-NEGATIVE signed-evolution CI lower bound is >0 AND MISSED-minus-PRESERVED signed-evolution CI upper bound is <0.
decision_rule_priority.LOCAL_SPECTRAL_EVOLUTION_ATTRIBUTION_IND: MISSED-minus-NEGATIVE signed-evolution CI satisfies lower bound <=0<= upper bound.
decision_rule_priority.EVENT_BLIND_LOCAL_SPECTRAL_EVOLUTION_COR: MISSED-minus-NEGATIVE signed-evolution CI upper bound is <0.
decision_rule_priority.boundary_case: If a zero endpoint prevents all strict/containment conditions above despite valid invariants, classify INDETERMINATE.
decision_rule_priority.decision_authority: Only the two named signed-evolution intervals enter classification. Descriptive observables, point effects, p-values and prior experiments cannot rescue or modify it.

numerical_constant_authority.2048_256_4096_8000_744: Inherited unchanged from the two compatible authoritative STFT representations.
numerical_constant_authority.one_adjacent_relation: Minimum native temporal relation; introduces no selected duration.
numerical_constant_authority.uniform_bins: Prevents learned, perceptual or Bass-specific weighting.
numerical_constant_authority.95_percent_interval: Inherited established JGA uncertainty procedure; sign/interval inference without an invented effect-size magnitude gate.
numerical_constant_authority.2000_resamples: Inherited from the immediately preceding frozen methodology; deterministic bounded percentile estimation.
numerical_constant_authority.80_percent_availability: Inherited CED-VAL-010 evidence-sufficiency invariant; never a source/correspondence threshold.
numerical_constant_authority.20260902_seed: Reproducibility identity only; no scientific decision effect.

deterministic_replay.pre_gt: Two fresh-process reconstructions of lightweight native-relation authority must be byte-identical and fingerprint-identical without reading BassDI.
deterministic_replay.evaluation: Two fresh-process evaluations must produce byte-identical canonical rows/results and identical fingerprints.
deterministic_replay.runtime: Runtime and absolute external root excluded from canonical serialization.

claim_firewall: no push or preservation without later approval
protocol_fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of jq -cS JSON after deleting protocol_fingerprint, including one trailing LF
